# CF-002: The tunnel runs more than one connector

- **Group:** Cloudflare Tunnel
- **Severity when it fails:** moderate
- **Root:** not needed

## Why it matters

One cloudflared replica is a single point of failure: when it restarts or crashes every hostname behind the tunnel is down. On a host whose only ingress is the tunnel, zero running connectors means the sites are down now.

## Verify by hand

```sh
pgrep -c cloudflared; cloudflared tunnel info <name>
```

## How to fix it

Run a second replica of the same tunnel (a second container or service with the same token or credentials)

## What a fix can break

Nothing; replicas of one tunnel share the load.
